# Friends in the Field


Feb 6


Written By[Evan Conners](https://didge.ai/updates?author=669e85f999ee9119208b4879)


Every jobsite Didge goes to the project teams are excited to welcome their new mascot. Some give names, some give a mouth and eyes, some just want a picture with Didge to share with their friends.


[Evan Conners](https://didge.ai/updates?author=669e85f999ee9119208b4879)
